CONNECTION_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This connection's sign-in expired. Reconnect it to keep using it.
CONNECTION_REFRESH_FAILED: The app didn't accept a fresh sign-in. Reconnect the account.
CONNECTION_PROVIDER_REJECTED: The app rejected these credentials. Check them and try again.
CONNECTION_UNREACHABLE: Nothing answered at this address. Check the URL and that the server is reachable from SurefyOS.
CONNECTION_REVOKED: This connection was disconnected and can't be changed. Add a new connection instead.
CONNECTION_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: SurefyOS can't connect to this app yet.
CONNECTION_AUTH_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: This app doesn't support that way of signing in. Choose another one.
CONNECTION_BASE_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: This address isn't allowed. Use an https:// address, or ask an owner to allow the host.
CONNECTION_DUPLICATE: This account is already connected here. Reconnect the existing connection instead.
CONNECTION_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: You signed in to a different account. Sign in to the account this connection uses.
CONNECTION_OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: This sign-in attempt expired or was already used. Start again.
CONNECTION_OAUTH_DENIED: The sign-in wasn't completed. Try again and allow access.
